question: Should OpenClaw add native model/provider hints to HEARTBEAT.md task blocks, or keep heartbeat tasks as one run and direct model-specific scheduled work to cron/plugin routing?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but any fix would add public task-file syntax or change model/session precedence; that is a product/API decision rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Keep heartbeat whole-turn routing
options.body: Document that HEARTBEAT.md tasks share one heartbeat model today and route model-specific standalone work through cron agent-turn jobs or plugin before_model_resolve routing.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md model hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields in task blocks, split due tasks by effective model, and add validation, docs, timestamp, and session-state tests.

options.title: Fold into cron override design
options.body: Treat this as overlap with the main-session cron model override track and decide both scheduled model-selection contracts together.

recommendation.title: Keep heartbeat whole-turn routing
recommendation.body: Document that HEARTBEAT.md tasks share one heartbeat model today and route model-specific standalone work through cron agent-turn jobs or plugin before_model_resolve routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily a core-vs-plugin/product-surface decision around an existing model-routing hook seam and new public HEARTBEAT.md syntax.
